page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: jus metu repressus Eggo minùs exorbitâ-re ausus fuit, donec tandem projecto metu, fœdereque contempto, profecta jam ætate,Monasteriensium patronorum fiducia insolentior factus ab irritata plebe est interemptus. Cujus mortem cùm filius Haiio ulcisceretur acerbiùs, ipsis Anno M.cccc. LXXVIIIcrudelitatem improbantibus Monaste-riensibus exorati à plebe Groningani, & propriis injuriis quoque lacessiti corrptis armis ejus arcem Weddanam in po-testatem redactam æquarunt solo. Prætorium imperium, quod Haiionis fuerat, sibi sumpsêre summa plebis voluntate, præfectum, qui jurisdictioni præesset, in arce Pekelborgia recèns à se structa collocarunt. Et ne Monasteriensés offenderent, solutis xxv auri Rhenani libris eos deliniverunt, & jus, quod hactenus Eggo & Haiio velut beneficio eorum illic tenuerant, redemerunt. Additaque pecuniæ datæ conditio, uti tantisper in possessione potestatis hujusce manēret civitas, donec pecunia ei esset restituta. page.notes: Top right corner: a small stain or mark, not transcribed. Bottom right: faint digitiser watermark, not transcribed. Marginal note text is printed in three short lines (Anno / M.cccc. / LXXVIII) and is joined here. Long s is normalised to s throughout. Two readings are uncertain: "ausus" (printed as "aufus") and "riensibus" (printed "riensibus"), where the long s may be misread; no [?] added because the letters are legible in context. The stray mark after "Haiio" is ignored. Sentence ends with "clien-" and continues on the next page.
